! Synthetic list in AdGuard DNS filtering syntax, exercising modifiers, exceptions, regex,
! and the browser/cosmetic rules that DNS filtering must skip.
! Written for TelltaleDNS tests; not copied from any published list.
! Homepage: https://example.com/dns-filter

! --- basic and exception rules
||ads.example.com^
@@||safe.ads.example.com^
@@|exact-allow.example.com^
||analytics.example.net^$important
@@||checkout.example.net^$important
example-caret.org^
*.wild.example.com
.dot-prefixed.example.com^

! --- modifiers
||ipv6-only.example.com^$dnstype=AAAA
||not-https.example.com^$dnstype=~HTTPS|~SVCB
||kids.example.org^$client=192.168.1.0/24|'Kids tablet'
||everyone-but-admin.example.org^$client=~10.0.0.2
||example.edu^$denyallow=mail.example.edu|login.example.edu
||rewritten.example.com^$dnsrewrite=NOERROR;A;192.0.2.1
||ads.example.com^$badfilter
||combined.example.com^$important,dnstype=A|AAAA

! --- regex rules
/^ad[0-9]+\.example\.(com|net)$/
/^track-[a-z]+\./$dnstype=A
@@/^allowed[0-9]*\.example\.com$/

! --- valid syntax DNS filtering ignores (counted as unsupported)
||ads.example.com/banner.js
||popups.example.com^$third-party
||script.example.com^$script,domain=example.org
||tagged.example.com^$ctag=device_tv
example.com##.ad-banner
example.com#@#.sponsored
example.com#?#div:has(> .ad)
example.com#$#body { overflow: auto !important; }
example.com$$script[data-ad]
||wild*card.example.com^
/banner/ads/

! --- malformed
||^
||bad name.example.com^
||ads.example.com^$dnstype=NOPE
@@||allow-denyallow.example.com^$denyallow=x.example.com
/^(unclosed/
